Regarding Case
ID0373334
, we would like to inform you that the case has been active in the RC queue for 63 days. The solution provided by the NOC is clearly detailed in the email communication. However, we have not observed significant progress on the case in the past 63 days.
The delays from RCs on cases in ISP, are impacting the overall case MTTR. Hence, we will be proceeding with the closure of this case.
Please take the following actions as applicable:
1. Spare part ordering
2. Field Service
If you need to document the field service report after the work, please note that it is still possible to update the service reports or document activities in a closed case. Follow these instructions:
1.        Search for the case in ISP.
2.        Click on “Create a timeline record.”
3.        Select “Notes.”
4.        Add a description and attach the file.
5.        Click “Add note” and close.
Thank you.
With best regards,
